title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Response Message Parser Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, diff hygiene, and full local Release solution test for RFC 9461 DNS response parsing.
scope: This verification covers DNS response header count parsing, question parsing, compressed owner-name parsing, SVCB answer dispatch to AliasMode and ServiceMode parsers, Additional-section Internet-class A and AAAA extraction, unsupported record skipping, non-Internet address skipping, and malformed message rejection for truncation, cyclic compression, malformed SVCB RDATA, malformed A RDATA, and trailing bytes.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
AliasMode parsing remains owned by `REQ-QUIC-RFC9461-0040` and ServiceMode RDATA parsing remains owned by `REQ-QUIC-RFC9461-0039`.
procedure: Run `dotnet test Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` before final goal completion.
expected_result: The focused requirement-home tests pass, the DNS project builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, generated triage reports the new requirement as trace-clean, diff hygiene passes, and the full local Release solution test suite remains green before final goal completion.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 DNS response parser for SVCB answers and Additional-section address hints is trace-owned and verified. DNSSEC, operator publication, IKEv2 exchange integration, host resolver installation, platform advertisement adapters, and encrypted DNS session establishment remain future work.
